svg.title: Beauty Rose: two maternal branches from Sakai Fish Farm
svg.desc: Follow lines from each dam to her daughters. Beauty Rose is the mother of Beauty IV and Big Rose. Beauty IV is the mother of Sumire, a Kohaku. Big Rose is the mother of Fujin, Aphrodite and Tulip, all Taisho Sanshoku. Seven fish selected from Sakai Fish Farm Parent Koi 2016, printed pages 8, 20, 29, 50 and 51.
